notes: Launch-timing harness for a packaged copy, and the boot marks it reads. scripts/lib/packagedApp.ts takes the build-and-drive pieces out of scripts/e2e-updater.ts as a pure move (sh, findIdentity, waitForReleaseTrain, pack with the harness block, pidsAt/killAt, portFree, the Cdp class now with protocol event handlers, pageTarget/attach; the page match is now url.endsWith('/index.html') so it accepts the app scheme that follows); e2e-updater.ts imports them and its flow, constants and check lines do not change. scripts/e2e-launch-timing.ts (bun run script:e2e-launch-timing) packs one signed, un-notarized copy under /private/tmp/tc-launch-timing with bundle id dev.landon.tempcode.e2e, its own userData, CDP 9234, a dead loopback feed and TEMP_CODE_COMPILE_CACHE under its root, launches it N times (default 4: Chromium stamps on launch 1, produces its code cache on 2, consumes from 3) with --trace-startup=v8,devtools.timeline,disabled-by-default-v8.compile in json for 8 s, and per launch attaches over CDP, waits for the renderer's tc:ready mark, counts console errors, calls session.list, waits for the trace, quits through window.api.app.confirmQuit() (SIGKILL after 30 s = FAIL) and parses the launch log ([boot] index/ready-to-show/server-start/db-open/first-session-list, the compile-cache line), the trace (the v8.compile event of assets/index-<hash>.js with consumedCacheSize, cacheRejected, cacheKind, notStreamedReason and streamed; whether v8.produceCache named it; V8.Compile* count and summed dur) and the disk (Code Cache/js and the compile cache directory). It prints a table and PASS/FAIL lines: file:// gets no produceCache and no consumedCacheSize; the Part 1 and Part 2 checks switch on when the launch log says compile-cache=on and when the page URL is tempcode-app://. Flags: --reuse, --app <bundle>, --launches N, --label, --no-trace, --seed-app <bundle> (one untimed launch of an older copy on the fresh userData to seed a file:// localStorage the app under test must migrate). Marks: bootMark('index', start=<epoch> compile-cache=on|off) as the first statement of src/main/index.ts (Electron init + the compile of index.js; start aligns renderer marks), bootMark('ready-to-show', slot) in windows.ts, performance.mark('tc:ready') in main.tsx beside html.ready.
